title: SPY Daily Moving Average Trend 50/200
description: Evaluate whether a long-flat moving average trend strategy using 50-day and 200-day moving averages shows robust historical performance on SPY daily data.
rationale: The 50/200 moving average crossover is a widely known trend-following approach. This experiment tests whether it produces useful risk-adjusted behavior on the available SPY dataset under Quant Lab execution semantics.
expected_benefit: Capture medium-to-long-term upward trends while reducing exposure during prolonged bearish periods.
expected_tradeoff: The strategy may react slowly to regime changes, miss part of strong recoveries, and suffer whipsaw losses during sideways markets.
success_criteria: The strategy should demonstrate competitive risk-adjusted performance versus buy-and-hold with acceptable drawdown and sufficient trade history to justify further validation.
rejection_criteria: Reject the hypothesis if the strategy materially underperforms the benchmark on risk-adjusted return, exhibits unacceptable drawdown, or shows evidence that performance depends excessively on a narrow historical period.
reconsideration_conditions: Reconsider if materially more historical data becomes available, execution assumptions change, or later parameter-sensitivity evidence suggests a more robust neighboring configuration.
